description: SwiftUI view and associated model for managing system run settings, including agent selection, security policies, allowlist management, and related UI components.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSettingsModel
classes.description: Observable model managing the state and logic for the system run settings, including agent configurations, security settings, allowlist entries, and fetching/updating remote data.

classes.name: ExecAllowlistEntry
classes.description: Represents an individual allowlist pattern entry with metadata like last used date and command.

classes.name: SystemRunSettingsView
classes.description: SwiftUI view that provides UI components for configuring system run permissions, policies, agent selection, and allowlist management.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSettingsTab
classes.description: Enumeration representing the different tabs in the settings view: Access and Allowlist.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest agent list and settings for the selected agent, and refreshes skill bins.

methods.name: selectAgent
methods.description: Selects a new agent ID and loads its specific settings.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads settings (security, ask, fallback, autoAllowSkills, allowlist entries) for a specified agent ID.

methods.name: setSecurity
methods.description: Updates the security configuration, persisting changes to global defaults or specific agent.

methods.name: setAutoAllowSkills
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic allowlisting of skill CLIs.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a new allowlist pattern after validating it.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing allowlist pattern entry after validation.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes an allowlist entry by its UUID.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Retrieves an allowlist entry by UUID.

methods.name: isPathPattern
methods.description: Checks if a pattern string is a valid path pattern.

methods.name: refreshSkillBins
methods.description: Fetches current skill bins for auto-allowlist feature, optionally forcing refresh.
